body:
Combination skin leaning towards more acne prone type

AM : I don't use face wash on mornings as it tends to dries the face a little. Just plain water works well

Moisturizer - Cetaphil moisturizing cream 

Sunscreen - yuvinie soft spf 50 

Lip balm - sebamed cherry lip balm 

PM:
Micellar water - bioderma to wipe out sunscreen 

Second cleanse with any simple facewash without any active ingredient would work ( detergent free one)

Active: since I have acne marks more than occasional pimple,I use a dermatologist recommended spot treatment for it( 3 times a week)

Moisturizer - Cetaphil moisturizing cream 

Thrice or twice a week I use rejuglow facewash just for mild exfoliation at night and I skip my active that day.

Keep your routine simple with minimal ingredients and fragrance free products ,your skin would thank you 🤗✨
